description: White Day: all of SERIFU/WHITE.BIN (base 0x80197000; game-internals 6u), 247 of 251 strings; the four '‥‥‥‥。' pauses stay. 13 sections from SHOUGATU.EXN's tables at 0x80145960 (tools/geko_sections.py --white): 0 Yuko, 1 Shiori, 2 Yuina, 3 Ijuin in the hallway, 4 Ayako, 5 Mira, 6 Mio, 7 Yukari, 8 Nozomi, 9 Megumi, 10 Saki, 11 the player's thoughts (who gets the special return), 12 Yumi. Each girl has four reactions by mood (delighted, pleased, polite, cold). Verified in DuckStation on forced White Days (force_white.py via xmas_run.ps1, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md 'White Day and Valentine's Day'): Ijuin's 1995/96 lines with both answers and his 1997 lines; the girl menu; Yuko, Mio and Saki delighted, Yuina pleased (mood 2), Mira polite (mood 3), Yumi cold (mood 4); each day ends normally. Checked only statically: the other girls and moods, natural triggers.
